purpose: Prepare the J-CV5 corpus-repair arm after MiniCPM5-2B capacity testing showed stable gains but persistent choice/score failures. Corpus v5 is a byte-identical v4 base plus eight independently authored repair families for choice k=6/12, ordinal score semantics, and Boolean risk boundaries. This document plans the remote training path but does not authorize GPU startup or training.

basis.root_cause: capacity is no longer the first binding constraint; heldout_v2 still degrades by candidate cardinality and score semantics, while high-coverage Boolean errors remain nonzero

run seed20 600-step LoRA training only if smoke passes
